description: This file defines the EmailService interface for the Book Project, outlining methods related to sending emails, including simple messages and template-based messages using Thymeleaf. It also includes a default method for extracting the username from an email address.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface defining email-related service methods for the Book Project.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a straightforward email message with specified sender, recipient, and message content.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Sends an email using a Thymeleaf template populated with provided variables.

methods.name: getUsernameFromEmail
methods.description: Default method extracting the username part from an email address.
